policies: There are no cancellations or refunds for weather.
Cruising Brigadoon operates rain or shine, as long as the weather conditions are safe.
Late Arrival Please make every effort to arrival at the time indicated for your charter.
Late Arrival - Private Charters Private charters start at the time scheduled.
Arrivals more than 1 hour late are considered no-shows and the charter is canceled without refund.
If you do not arrival before departure you are considered a no show and your charter (seat) is canceled without refund.
Cancellation By Guest (No-Refund Policy) Once you make a reservation with Cruising Brigadoon it is considered a confirmed booking.
Once processed by Fare Harbor or by Cruising Brigadoon if completed over the phone your booking is Non-Refundable UNLESS YOU PURCHASE TRIP PROTECTION.
